title: AgentFlow — External calls
description: Outbound (client) spans by server address and integration provider.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['server.address'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE kind = 3 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['server.address'] AS label, 100 * countIf(has_error) / count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE kind = 3 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['server.address'] AS label, quantile(0.95)(duration_nano) / 1e6 AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE kind = 3 AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT attributes_string['af.integration.provider'] AS provider, attributes_string['af.outcome'] AS outcome, count() AS calls, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_nano) / 1e6, 1) AS p95_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'integration.http' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY provider, outcome ORDER BY calls DESC LIMIT 100

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AS ts, attributes_string['af.integration.provider'] AS label, count() AS value FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE name = 'integration.http' AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY ts, label ORDER BY ts
